_comment: ADDITIVE overlay for specs/webex-cloud-calling.json — see tools/spec_overlay.py.
specs/ is a verbatim upstream mirror (update-specs.py overwrites it), so an
endpoint upstream omits must be re-added here or it is lost on every pull.
Additive only: if upstream publishes one of these paths, the drift gate fails
and the entry must be deleted. Schemas below are transcribed from LIVE
responses, not from any SDK — every field was proven by GET/PUT read-back.

x-wxcli-overlay.reason: Live endpoint absent from Cisco's published spec. Never present in any revision (`git log -S 'cxEssentials/callRecordings' -- specs/` is empty), so the generator produced no command and docs/reference/call-features-additional.md documented a command that never existed for ~4 months.
x-wxcli-overlay.evidence: Verified live against org ahobgood-lab on 2026-07-14 with a throwaway CX Essentials queue: GET -> 200 with a BroadWorks-backed payload (serviceProvider/externalGroup populated); PUT {enabled:true,record:'Always'} -> 204, and a follow-up GET read-back confirmed both values persisted. Every field in the schemas below was proven writable by read-back. NOTE: this API returns 204 for unknown fields and silently drops them (PUT {bogusFieldXyz:...} -> 204, absent on read-back), so a 204 alone proves nothing here — only read-back does.
x-wxcli-overlay.remove_when: Cisco publishes this path upstream; the drift gate will fail with 'overlay is stale' and this entry must be deleted.

get.description: Retrieve a Customer Assist call queue's call recording settings. Recording configuration lives ONLY in this sub-resource — the call queue payload itself carries no recording fields, so `call-queue show/update` cannot read or write it. Requires `spark-admin:people_read` (NOT the telephony_config scope the other Customer Assist endpoints use).

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The location ID where the call queue resides.

parameters.name: queueId
parameters.description: The Customer Assist call queue ID whose recording settings are read.

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The organization ID of the customer or partner's organization.

400.description: Bad Request: The request was invalid or cannot be otherwise served.

401.description: Unauthorized: Authentication credentials were missing or incorrect.

403.description: Forbidden: Call Queue Recording Settings API access can be restricted via Control Hub by a full administrator.

404.description: Not Found: The queue does not exist, or Customer Assist is not enabled on it.

put.description: Configure a Customer Assist call queue's call recording settings. Requires `spark-admin:people_write` (NOT the telephony_config scope the other Customer Assist endpoints use). Behaves as a PARTIAL MERGE, not a replace: fields omitted from the body retain their previous value (live-verified — `record` stayed set across a PUT that omitted it). WARNING: returns 204 for unrecognised fields and silently discards them — always read the settings back to confirm a write landed.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The location ID where the call queue resides.

parameters.name: queueId
parameters.description: The Customer Assist call queue ID whose recording settings are modified.

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The organization ID of the customer or partner's organization.

204.description: No Content — settings accepted. Unrecognised fields are silently dropped; read back to confirm.

400.description: Bad Request: The request was invalid or cannot be otherwise served.

401.description: Unauthorized: Authentication credentials were missing or incorrect.

403.description: Forbidden: Call Queue Recording Settings API access can be restricted via Control Hub by a full administrator.

404.description: Not Found: The queue does not exist, or Customer Assist is not enabled on it.

type.description: Notification played to participants while recording. Live-verified values: `None`, `Beep`.

enabled.description: Whether the recording notification is played.

interval.description: Seconds between repeats of the recording notification. Live-verified: 15 (default), 30.

enabled.description: Whether the notification repeats during the call.

internalCallsEnabled.description: Play the start/stop announcement on internal calls.

pstnCallsEnabled.description: Play the start/stop announcement on PSTN calls.

ModifyQueueCallRecordingPayload.description: Writable queue call recording settings. Every field below was proven writable by live PUT-then-GET read-back on 2026-07-14.

enabled.description: Whether call recording is enabled for the queue.

record.description: When to record. Live-verified value: `Always`. Other values are not asserted here because they have not been verified against the live API.

GetQueueCallRecordingObject.description: Queue call recording settings as returned by the live API.

enabled.description: Whether call recording is enabled for the queue.

record.description: When calls are recorded. Only returned once recording is enabled.

serviceProvider.description: Read-only. Recording vendor's service provider ID (BroadWorks-backed).

externalGroup.description: Read-only. Recording vendor's external group ID.

externalIdentifier.description: Read-only. Recording vendor's external identifier for this queue.
